name: +1 Loot To Forge
creator: Good Bro Studio
redeem: Launch +1 Loot To Forge on Roblox and finish the short opening tutorial.
Click the Shop button (the trolley icon) on the left side of the screen.
Scroll all the way to the bottom of the Shop window to find the code box.
Type or paste the code into the box and press Submit.
notes:
+1 Loot To Forge is an incremental combat game from Good Bro Studio that launched on Roblox in August 2026. Every click adds a little more power, which you use to clear out hordes of enemies, collect ore from the fallen, and forge that ore into stronger weapons and armour. Better gear lets you push into tougher areas, and a race system adds bonus stats you can reroll for better damage modifiers.

Codes here usually hand out Ember Stones, coins, race rerolls or Power Potions, which speed up forging and let you chase a stronger race without grinding for it. The developer has tied new codes to concurrent player milestones such as 20,000, 30,000 and 50,000 players online, announcing them on the game page and in the Discord server.

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming +1 Loot To Forge codes?
faq.a: Finish the tutorial first. The Shop and its code box unlock after it.

faq.q: How does +1 Loot To Forge usually release new codes?
faq.a: New codes have been tied to concurrent player milestones such as 20,000, 30,000 and 50,000 players online, and are named after them, like 50000CCU. The developer posts them on the game page and in the Discord server.

faq.q: What are Ember Stones, race rerolls and Power Potions good for?
faq.a: They speed up forging and let you chase a stronger race without grinding. Your race gives bonus stats, so a reroll can land you better damage modifiers.

faq.q: Where is the code box in +1 Loot To Forge?
faq.a: Open the Shop with the trolley icon on the left side of the screen, then scroll to the very bottom of the Shop window.
